scope: Full delivered HTML parsing/execution, strict DOM ancestry and actual control events. Canvas/timers stubbed; no browser layout/device acceptance.

checks.name: Full application startup completes without exceptions
All adopted UI mounts in the document after the existing canvas wrapper
Original appearance, Retro toggle and both densities preserve project and starter ROM
Resources opens, renders live previews/relationships, and closes from its controls
Connected Workspace opens all five panels and closes without editing the project
Follow selection and matching metasprite controls use the selected Scene
Replay shortcut opens its mounted controls and retains the canvas owner
No application/DOM errors occur during the control interactions
Local-file startup works when preference storage is unavailable
Stored Retro/Comfortable preference restores on a new document
